provenance.scope: Exploratory development evidence only, extending development_factorial_density_width.json with two additional length-density levels (0.01, 0.03) and a second method (baseline_skeleton, the minimum-turn skeleton tracer), both restricted to bundle width 6px (Stages 1-3 negative control already established width is inert for this family). The primary locked evaluation was never read or touched.

generator.params: None -> synth_thick.thick_params() defaults, identical to the existing factorial (verified: width_range, occlusion_prob, false_pos overridden; all other keys match synth_generator.default_params()).
generator.note_on_geometry_family: generate_geometry_sequence draws filaments sequentially from np.random.default_rng(seed) independent of the requested max density, and only the stopping point (arc length) differs; the 0.01/0.03 scenes generated here for a given seed are therefore prefixes of the exact same underlying per-seed geometry sequence used for the existing 0.02/0.04/0.06 scenes, so the geometry family is directly comparable.
generator.note_on_degradation_seed_offsets: degradation_seed/sem_noise_seed = seed + 100000/200000 + density_index*10000, where density_index is the position within the density tuple PASSED TO THIS CALL. Because the new 0.01/0.03 scenes were generated via a separate call with densities=(0.01,0.03) rather than a single 5-level call, their density_index is 0/1 (not 0/2 as it would be within a unified 5-level run). This only changes which RNG stream seeds the mask-degradation/SEM-noise draw for those two density levels; it does not affect the geometry sequence (see note above) or reproducibility -- it is documented here so the exact seed value is traceable, not hand-picked.

input_mask.name: mask.png
input_mask.description: The degraded, nominal one-pixel-axis mask (byte-identical to mask_w1.png in all 20 scenes measured here). Its actual mean foreground width is NOT 1px -- the degradation model adds thickness -- confirmed by direct skeleton-based measurement over all 20 scenes in this sweep, consistent with the single-scene figure (1.72px) already established for the parent factorial.
